scene_jp: <ruby>老人<rt>ろうじん</rt></ruby>の<ruby>目<rt>め</rt></ruby>がすっと<ruby>細<rt>ほそ</rt></ruby>くなった。「おばあさんから<ruby>聞<rt>き</rt></ruby>いた、だと？」と<ruby>彼<rt>かれ</rt></ruby>はゆっくり<ruby>繰<rt>く</rt></ruby>り<ruby>返<rt>かえ</rt></ruby>した。<ruby>店<rt>みせ</rt></ruby>の<ruby>奥<rt>おく</rt></ruby>からかすかな<ruby>時計<rt>とけい</rt></ruby>の<ruby>音<rt>おと</rt></ruby>が<ruby>聞<rt>き</rt></ruby>こえてくる<ruby>中<rt>なか</rt></ruby>、<ruby>老人<rt>ろうじん</rt></ruby>は<ruby>引<rt>き</rt></ruby>き<ruby>出<rt>だ</rt></ruby>しを<ruby>開<rt>あ</rt></ruby>けて、<ruby>小<rt>ちい</rt></ruby>さな<ruby>封筒<rt>ふうとう</rt></ruby>を<ruby>取<rt>と</rt></ruby>り<ruby>出<rt>だ</rt></ruby>した。「これはずっとお<ruby>前<rt>まえ</rt></ruby>に<ruby>渡<rt>わた</rt></ruby>すつもりだったんだ。あのおばあさんが<ruby>頼<rt>たの</rt></ruby>んでいったものだからな。」<ruby>封筒<rt>ふうとう</rt></ruby>にはテストという<ruby>名前<rt>なまえ</rt></ruby>が<ruby>書<rt>か</rt></ruby>かれていた。
scene_translation: The old man's eyes narrowed slowly. "You heard about this from an old woman, you say?" he repeated quietly. From the back of the shop came the faint sound of a clock ticking. The old man opened a drawer and took out a small envelope. "I always meant to give this to you. Because that old woman left it here and asked me to." Written on the envelope was the name: テスト.
grammar_note: 【〜てくる】This pattern attaches to a verb to express something coming toward the speaker or gradually entering awareness. Here, 「<ruby>聞<rt>き</rt></ruby>こえてくる」means the sound of the clock "came drifting" to the player's ears — something from the background reaching you. Compare 〜ていく (moving away). It can also express change over time: だんだんわかってくる (gradually coming to understand).

feedback: Good effort — your meaning came through clearly, and the particle から was used correctly to show the source of the information. The part to fix is 「聞いたです」: in Japanese, です follows nouns and な-adjectives, not plain verb forms. For a verb like 聞く, the polite past form is 聞きました. A natural correction would be 「おばあさんから聞きました」.

mystery_memo: The mystery deepens: the unnamed old woman from scene 1 had visited the tobacco shop BEFORE the player arrived, leaving an envelope addressed to テスト by name — she knew the player was coming. The old shopkeeper (じいさん) handed it over with evident relief, as though fulfilling a long-held obligation; he is no longer suspicious but still clearly frightened of something connected to the woman. The envelope (古い封筒) is now in the player's inventory and contains an unknown message that will be central to Act 2. The woman's foreknowledge of the player's identity is the core anomaly.
